name: Object Hero + Question
description: A 16:9 explainer cover with one concrete object or artifact as the hero and a complete exact episode-title question rendered directly in a dominant title-safe band.
composition_guidance: Use one concrete object or artifact as the undisputed hero in the lower two-thirds of the 16:9 frame. Reserve an uncluttered upper-third title-safe band for the complete exact episode-title question rendered directly by the selected image model. The active Visual Style remains the final authority for medium, palette, texture, lighting, and rendering technique.
composition_rules: Reserve the upper third as an uncluttered title-safe band for the complete exact episode title.
Place one concrete object or artifact as the undisputed hero in the lower two-thirds.
Keep the object silhouette and the title equally legible at small-screen size.
Use the title band and object as one immediate reading path without a second hero.
required_elements: One concrete object or artifact as the hero
A complete exact episode title rendered directly by the selected image model
avoid_elements: A collage, montage, or second competing hero
Logos, channel branding, watermarks, copied assets, or copied trade dress
Post-render typography compositing or overlay text
Misspelled, clipped, placeholder, or illegible title text
headline_guidance: Render the complete exact episode title directly in the upper title-safe band. Do not paraphrase, abbreviate, add extra text, or use post-render typography compositing. Use one, two, or three balanced lines only as required to preserve the exact title and small-screen readability.
visual_style_guidance: The recipe controls only the one-object hierarchy and upper title-safe band. The active Visual Style remains authoritative for medium, palette, texture, lighting, and rendering details.
